text: Mechanisms are designed in a certain way, but we need also always to look at these mechanisms or techniques or solutions, with a critical eye. That means we need to look at them and ask ourselves: Is this really good in under all conditions, under all situations, or not? There may be aspects of technology that are not that good, not always, and we need to be aware of that. Okay, so whenever we design a system, whenever we design a technological solution, we need to account for possible issues that may arise. So an idea may be good to solve one problem, but it might actually make things worse in other situations. So we need also to look at the big picture when we design a technology.
